agent_explanation: Controller for body 1 divides by distance to waypoint without guarding zero. At step 1227 body 1 has arrived exactly at waypoint (7.1351610300980255,9.598579837937455) with ~zero velocity (~2.8e-13), so distance=0. Next step's controller force computation does 0/0 -> NaN, which propagates to body 1 position/velocity and total energy at step 1228. Moving the waypoint 0.5m away avoids the zero-distance case and eliminates NaN.
